spans.s:
अभेद अ-भेद, अस्, m. absence of difference
or distinction; identity; not breaking, compactness,
closeness of array; (अस्, आ, अम्), undivided, identical,
alike.

अ-भेदक, अस्, इका, अम्, not dividing, not dis-
tinguishing.

अ-भेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-भैदिक, अस्, ई, अम्,
not to be divided or broken or pierced; indivisible;
(-यम्), n. a diamond.
—अभेद्य-ता, f. indivisibility,
impenetrability.

आभेरी आभेरी, f. one of the Rāgiṇīs or
modes of music, personified as a female.
